caption: The drawing depicts a garment resembling a woman's high-necked bodice or blouse insert, shown from the front against a plain, off-white background. The main part of the garment is a light beige color and has a slightly rough texture, with decorative floral lace patterns in white arranged symmetrically on both sides of the high collar and down the front. The lace patterns include stylized flowers and leaves, with denser lace work on the collar and more scattered floral motifs extending vertically along the garment. The bottom section of the garment is a paler beige or cream color, made of a more sheer, gauzy fabric, and includes two narrow hanging ties or ribbons. The composition centers the garment on the page, and the artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Cream Net Vestee
